page.layout: One page of running text, with one marginal note in the left margin beside the paragraph on the Laconians. Running head at the top centre. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: noi gli rimettiamo à i nostri debitori. E non ci indurre in tentatione: ma liberaci dal male. Percioche tuo è il regno, la potentia, & la gloria in sempiterno, Amen.
¶ IVDAEORVM lingua eadem est, quæ Hebræa.
¶ IVHRI, vide Hungari. Iidem sunt Vgri. Rhuteni quidem pro g pronunciant h[?] pro Iugra, Iuhra.

¶ LACONVM ut regio à media Græcia remotior est: sic lingua etiam eorum à communi recessit longius, &, ut apparet in plurimis ad Doricam accedit. Lacedæmonii Crœsi tempore inter Dores excelluerunt, Herodotus. Glossæ quædam, id est dictiones huic linguæ peculiares, ab Hesychio annotantur: ut Κλα[?], κλινάριον μικρὸν[?]. Nuces magnas μυχνῆρς[?] vocabant, τυνίης[?] autem nuces dulces, Athenæus libro secundo. Et paulò post, Μυχνῆρς[?] Lacones vocant amygdala. Plutarchus Laconum apophthegmata copiosè descripsit: & in vita quoque Lycurgi multa Laconum tum vocabula, tum dicta enumerat. τὶν[?] pro σοι, ἄμμες[?] pro ἡμεῖς. τῖνας[?] pro ἐκείνας[?]. ChorusLaconica lingua affinis Dorica.

page.notes: Lower right of page: catchword "rus". No page number printed. Doubtful: "h:" after "pronunciant" (abbreviation unclear). Greek words are copied with uncertainty, especially Κλα, κλινάριον μικρὸν, μυχνῆρς, τυνίης, τὶν, ἄμμες, τῖνας and ἐκείνας; these need checking against the scan at higher resolution. Marginal note is split over three lines ("affi / nis") and is given as one word "affinis". Hyphen at "Ægyptia-" line end is read as a printed hyphen.
